permittedChanges: Replace any value shown in the prototype with the same value read from a verified query.
Let the value strip wrap onto more or fewer lines under the shipped font's metrics; its position between the caption and the plot is fixed, and it never moves into the plot or below the figure.
Extend each figure's accessible table to the full represented window where the prototype truncates it.

Use the repository's own overlay-label mechanism in site/visuals/report-shared.js in place of the prototype's; what binds is each label's position, alignment, colour and content, not the technique that places it.
Resolve the behaviour past six selected countries without a further approval, by either capping the selection or dropping the direct end labels so that the value strip carries country identity alone.
